_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

title.en: Talk about the birth before it is urgent
title.hi: जन्म की बात कीजिए, ज़रूरत पड़ने से पहले

body.en: What she wants, what frightens her, what she wants you to do if a decision has to be made fast. This conversation is calm now and impossible later.
body.hi: वे क्या चाहती हैं, उन्हें किस बात से डर लगता है, और अगर तेज़ी से फ़ैसला लेना पड़े तो वे आपसे क्या चाहती हैं। यह बातचीत अभी शांत है और बाद में नामुमकिन।
